blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Tourism is changing faster than the destinations themselves, raising a crucial question: Who is actually deciding what comes next? After nine years after its last staging in 2017—and a forced postponement in 2025 following earthquakes and typhoons in Cebu, the Youth Tourism Congress (YTC) is making its long-awaited return. First established sixteen years ago, the historic platform officially marked its revival as fourth-year BS Tourism Management students from the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) convened a press conference at the main campus’s NQ Hall.
